jei.sagittary.component_arrow.title: Component Arrow
jei.sagittary.tip.flint.desc: Standard arrow tip. No special effects.
jei.sagittary.tip.amethyst.desc: Applies Slowness effect on hit. Creates purple particle trail.
jei.sagittary.tip.copper.desc: 10% chance to summon lightning on hit.
jei.sagittary.tip.slime.desc: Arrow bounces off blocks AND entities up to 4 times.
jei.sagittary.tip.glowstone.desc: Applies Glowing effect on hit (like Spectral Arrows). Glowstone+Stick+Feather in fletching table makes Spectral Arrows.
jei.sagittary.tip.echo_shard.desc: Sonic boom arrow. Creates AOE damage burst on impact (entity or block).
jei.sagittary.tip.ender_pearl.desc: Teleports entities on hit. Hitting a block teleports the shooter.
jei.sagittary.tip.iron.desc: Heavy arrow with 40% more gravity. Armor piercing - 30% of damage bypasses armor.
jei.sagittary.tip.diamond.desc: Piercing arrow - passes through up to 4 entities with reduced damage per pierce.
jei.sagittary.shaft.breeze_rod.desc: Lightweight homing arrow. 40% less gravity, 25% faster, seeks nearest enemy, strong knockback.
jei.sagittary.shaft.bone.desc: Smite effect - deals 2.5x damage to undead mobs.
jei.sagittary.fletching.paper.desc: Faster but destroyed on ground hit.
jei.sagittary.quiver.desc: Stores up to 256 arrows. Bows automatically use arrows from quivers. Right-click in inventory to add/remove arrows.
jei.sagittary.iron_bow.desc: A more durable bow made of iron. 1.5x durability and slightly increased range.
jei.sagittary.iron_crossbow.desc: A more durable crossbow made of iron. 1.5x durability and increased range.
jei.sagittary.compound_bow.desc: Shoots 3 arrows in a spread pattern. Consumes 3 arrows per shot.
jei.sagittary.repeater_crossbow.desc: A rapid-fire crossbow with reduced reload time.
